def factor_volume_instability_logcv(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    log_vol = np.log1p(df_copy["volume"])
    vol_mean = log_vol.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_std = log_vol.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    cv = vol_std / vol_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    cv = cv.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_volume_instability_logcv"] = cv
    return df_copy["factor_volume_instability_logcv"]
description: Coefficient of variation of trailing 20-day log-transformed volume. Log transformation compresses large-volume spikes, focusing on proportional (multiplicative) volatility in liquidity provision rather than absolute dollar-volume swings. This reduces outlier distortion and may improve MI and payoff thickness while preserving the parent's stable ICIR/RankICIR and cross-sectional ordering of liquidity instability.
